anti_overfit_boundary: All coefficients, seeds, race counts, worlds, ablation definitions and thresholds are fixed before scoring.
No threshold, coefficient, field set or seed changes after seeing results.
No real PRE row values, real outcomes, RESULT/PAYOUT, odds, prices or economics are used.

decision_rule.field_material_dependence: For a missing field, classify a world as materially dependent when ablation mean KL / N2_FULL mean KL >= 1.10 on both seeds.
decision_rule.sibling_broad_synthetic_viability: S0 ratio to N2_FULL <= 1.25 for every W0-W4 world on both seeds.
decision_rule.sibling_partial_synthetic_viability: If broad viability fails, classify partial viability only if S0 ratio <= 1.15 on W0 and <= 1.35 on W3 and W4 on both seeds.

dev2000_schema_basis.reason_for_not_using_other_available_fie: No preregistered simulator-spec coefficient mapping exists for the remaining tactical/history fields; sibling v1 deliberately uses the lowest-freedom subset rather than tuning synthetic coefficients after scoring.

purpose: Quantify synthetic dependence of Frozen N2 on the five DEV2000-missing direct inputs and test a separate low-freedom sibling model using only DEV2000-available PRE field families.
